chapter.title: The Eden Club
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 from the PowerPyx 100% chart (37 nodes, two bracket phases), the chapter template on detroitbecometext resolved against en.json (7 prompts, 4 clues, 12 arrows) and the Fandom wiki. INVESTIGATE EDEN CLUB → [ SEARCH FOR CLUES ] → REPAIR ANDROID → TALK TO ANDROID (AGGRESSIVE / CALM APPROACH) → LEAVE CRIME SCENE → FIND AN ANDROID EYEWITNESS → ASK HANK TO HELP → PURSUE DEVIANT → ENTER THE WAREHOUSE → [ SEARCH FOR BLUE HAIRED DEVIANT ] → INVESTIGATE BLUE HAIRED DEVIANT → DEVIANTS ATTACK → WIN FIGHT (SHOOT DEVIANT → DEVIANT KILLS HERSELF WITH CONNOR’S GUN → DEVIANTS DIED, or SPARE DEVIANT → DEVIANTS ESCAPED) or LOSE FIGHT (SHOOT DEVIANTS IN THE BACK → CONNOR SHOT DEVIANTS, or LET DEVIANTS GO → DEVIANTS ESCAPED). Three timeouts end in MISSION FAILED (two cards): GIVE UP on the club floor, ANDROIDS’ MEMORIES ARE RESET, and GIVE UP in the warehouse, each Hank small down. Spare: Hank and instability large up; shoot: both large down. No Amanda or public-opinion change; Connor cannot die. Cross-chapter: the Tracis’ fate (The Bridge, Public Enemy, Last Chance, Crossroads, Night of the Soul). Researched in docs/research/ch20-the-eden-club.md.

decisions.title: Investigate Eden Club (checkpoint), Follow Hank, On Crime Scene, Listen to Briefing
decisions.context: A hungover Hank and Connor arrive at the Eden Club; Ben points them to the room; Gavin calls the victim “some pervert who got more action than he could handle” and leaves.

benchmark.note: A narrated event quoting the template; no stat change.

decisions.title: Search for clues → Repair android
decisions.context: The victim (GRAHAM, MICHAEL), the bruising (strangled), the heart (no cardiac event), the blue blood (WR400 #429 671 942), the damaged Traci, Hank and the wallet.

options.label: INVESTIGATE VICTIM / INVESTIGATE ANDROID
options.effect: The template’s four clues and the android’s scans, in any order.

options.label: REPAIR ANDROID
options.effect: Reactivates the Traci for a minute, maybe less.

decisions.gate: Free roam in the crime scene; no timer.
decisions.note: The bracket SEARCH FOR CLUES; ANALYZE BLOOD is an unused chart string.

benchmark.note: A hub unrolled into seven consecutive copies; reactivating needs the neck, the heart and the android examined (the exact trigger is not published).

decisions.title: Talk to android → Aggressive or Calm approach
decisions.context: Four prompts before the damaged Traci shuts down: EXPLAIN / DIRECT / SOOTHE; MURDERER / FACTS (VICTIM is cut); MURDERER / PRESSURE / ALONE; KILLER / WHAT MODEL / OTHER ANDROID.

options.label: AGGRESSIVE APPROACH
options.effect: DIRECT, MURDERER or PRESSURE (PowerPyx and readers). No effect.

decisions.note: No option carries an arrow in the template.

benchmark.note: Four decision scenes with the game’s labels; the approach is recorded in edenApproach. VICTIM is not offered (its content is unused).

decisions.title: Leave crime scene (checkpoint) → find an android eyewitness, ask Hank to help, or give up
decisions.context: Hank goes to question the manager. The Traci in the booth facing the crime-scene door saw the second android leave, but only a human can rent her. If Connor takes too long Hank wants to leave: CONTINUE or GIVE UP.

options.label: ASK HANK TO HELP
options.effect: Hank rents the booth Traci ($29.99); her memory shows a blue-haired Traci heading for the entrance.

options.label: CONTINUE
options.effect: One more minute; if it runs out Connor gives up on his own (Hank small down).

decisions.note: Chart: GIVE UP (arrow) and the first MISSION FAILED card.

benchmark.note: The idle timer is an action budget (three actions, then the prompt; two more after CONTINUE); the sizes are not sourced. Waiting is offered as an action.

decisions.title: Pursue deviant or androids’ memories are reset
decisions.context: Connor follows the blue-haired Traci from one rented android’s memory to the next before the club’s two-hour wipe: the front dancer, pod 17, the red room, the blue room, a private room, the cleaning android, the staff door.

options.label: PURSUE DEVIANT
options.effect: Reaches the staff door and ENTER THE WAREHOUSE.

decisions.note: Decided by speed in the game; no failure rate is published.

benchmark.note: Six hops, each a choice among three androids (the route is one reader’s sequence; the decoys are not sourced), with a second try after a miss; the fourth wrong probe is the reset.

decisions.title: Enter the warehouse (checkpoint), search for blue haired deviant, or give up
decisions.context: Discarded androids, blue blood, rA9 graffiti and two magazines; the trail of blue blood leads to a stack of Tracis in the corner. Waiting too long and Hank leaves.

options.label: INVESTIGATE BLUE HAIRED DEVIANT
options.effect: Two Tracis with yellow LEDs: DEVIANTS ATTACK.

decisions.note: The bracket SEARCH FOR BLUE HAIRED DEVIANT: READ “FIRST IMMORTAL”, ANALYZE BLUE BLOOD, INVESTIGATE ANDROID STOCK, GIVE UP, FIND RA9 SYMBOL, READ “NEW SUPERPOWERS”.

benchmark.note: A hub unrolled into five copies; the corner needs the blue blood (PowerPyx); five actions without it and Hank leaves (budget not sourced). The magazines are a media scene before the search.

decisions.title: Deviants attack: win fight or lose fight
decisions.context: The brown-haired Traci fights Connor through the storage room and into the alley while the blue-haired one fights Hank.

options.label: LOSE FIGHT
options.effect: LET DEVIANTS GO / SHOOT DEVIANTS IN THE BACK.

decisions.note: A quick-time fight; Connor cannot die (no skull, no death line).

benchmark.note: Two risk rolls (storage room 0.2, alley 0.1; unsourced), with the wiki’s two branching prompts as options.

decisions.title: Shoot or spare the Tracis?
decisions.context: After a won fight the brown-haired Traci runs at Connor; after a lost one both Tracis explain themselves and climb the fence with their backs turned.

options.label: SPARE (either fight)
options.effect: Hank and instability large up; DEVIANTS ESCAPED.

options.label: SHOOT after winning
options.effect: Connor shoots the brown-haired Traci; the other kills herself with his gun. Hank and instability large down; DEVIANTS DIED.

options.label: SHOOT after losing
options.effect: Both shot in the back. Hank and instability large down; CONNOR SHOT DEVIANTS.

decisions.note: The Tracis’ fate carries into The Bridge (four talks), Public Enemy (Amanda), Last Chance (the Traci evidence), Crossroads and Night of the Soul.

benchmark.note: Two prompts with the template’s arrows; the outcome is recorded in edenOutcome and edenTracis, and evidence.tracisDead when both die. The earlier Amanda changes are removed.
